title: 雨夜的未完画稿
logline: 刚辞职的迷茫插画师在旧书店躲雨，与温和的店主在一本绝版画册中找回了画画的初心与共鸣。

characters.name: 苏晚
characters.description: a 24-year-old woman with wavy brown hair tied in a low ponytail and amber eyes, carrying a canvas tote bag and wearing a yellow raincoat over a grey hoodie and blue jeans

characters.name: 陆川
characters.description: a 28-year-old man with short black hair and dark brown eyes wearing wire-rim glasses, a brown apron over a dark green knit sweater, and black trousers

scenes.description: a rainy street outside an old wooden bookstore glowing with warm interior light at night
a cozy vintage bookstore interior lined with towering wooden bookshelves under warm ambient lighting
a quiet corner inside the bookstore beside a rain-streaked window with a small wooden table and a glowing desk lamp

characters.action: running under the bookstore eaves while hugging her tote bag

panels.description: Su Wan rushes under the bookstore eaves to escape the pouring rain late at night

dialogue.speaker: su_wan
dialogue.text: 刚辞职就赶上暴雨，今天真是倒霉透了。

characters.action: holding a closed sign at the glass door and looking out at Su Wan

panels.description: Lu Chuan pauses as he is about to flip the closed sign, noticing the drenched woman outside

dialogue.speaker: lu_chuan
dialogue.text: 雨下得挺大，先进来避避吧。

characters.action: stepping onto the indoor doormat and shaking rain from her raincoat hood
holding the front door open with one hand

panels.description: Lu Chuan welcomes Su Wan into the warm, book-filled shop as she timidly steps inside

dialogue.speaker: su_wan
dialogue.text: 打扰了！等雨小一点我就走。

characters.action: handing a clean dry towel across the space
taking the towel with both hands

panels.description: Lu Chuan hands a clean towel to Su Wan, who receives it gratefully

dialogue.speaker: lu_chuan
dialogue.text: 不着急，反正店里也没别人。

characters.action: browsing along a tall bookshelf and pointing at a large hardbound volume

panels.description: Su Wan walks along the bookshelf and suddenly spots an unusual vintage artbook

dialogue.speaker: su_wan
dialogue.text: 咦……这本画册不是早就绝版了吗？

characters.action: holding the heavy illustrated artbook with sparkling eyes

panels.description: Su Wan holds the rare vintage artbook carefully in her hands with genuine awe

dialogue.speaker: su_wan
dialogue.text: 找了三年都没买到，竟然会在这里！

characters.action: turning around while still cradling the artbook
walking over carrying two steaming mugs of tea

panels.description: Lu Chuan walks up with warm tea as Su Wan turns to show him the artbook she found

dialogue.speaker: lu_chuan
dialogue.text: 眼光不错，这是上一任店主从海外淘回来的孤本。

characters.action: sitting on a wooden chair with the open artbook resting on the table
sitting opposite her, listening with arms resting on the wooden table

panels.description: Su Wan and Lu Chuan sit opposite each other by the rain-streaked window, immersed in conversation

dialogue.speaker: su_wan
dialogue.text: 我大学学插画时，最崇拜的就是这位画家的光影处理。

characters.action: gently tracing the edge of an illustration page with a melancholic smile

panels.description: Su Wan looks down at the intricate page with mixed feelings of fondness and exhaustion

dialogue.speaker: su_wan
dialogue.text: 今天刚辞掉商业插画的工作，差点以为自己已经不喜欢画画了。

characters.action: looking across at her with a gentle, reassuring gaze behind his glasses

panels.description: Lu Chuan speaks reassuringly to Su Wan while holding his warm cup of tea

dialogue.speaker: lu_chuan
dialogue.text: 喜欢画画的眼睛是藏不住的。你刚才看它时的眼神很亮。

characters.action: blinking with wide amber eyes reflecting the soft yellow lamplight

panels.description: Su Wan's amber eyes brighten with emotion as she hears Lu Chuan's sincere words

dialogue.speaker: su_wan
dialogue.text: 原来……我眼里的光还在啊。

characters.action: leaning slightly forward over the table with a bright smile
nodding gently while taking a sip of tea

panels.description: The heavy atmosphere dissolves as the two share a lighthearted, warm moment over the book

dialogue.speaker: lu_chuan
dialogue.text: 这本画册不卖，但只要雨天，随时欢迎你来看。

panels.description: The exterior of the bookstore in the late night as the heavy downpour subsides into a quiet drizzle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 不知不觉间，窗外的暴雨渐渐变成了温柔的细雨。

characters.action: pushing open the exit door and turning back to wave goodbye
standing beside the checkout counter waving back with a calm smile

panels.description: Su Wan steps out of the bookstore with renewed vitality, turning back to wave goodbye to Lu Chuan

dialogue.speaker: su_wan
dialogue.text: 陆店主，那我们下次雨天见！

source.sentence: 雨夜里，刚辞职的插画师苏晚在旧书店避雨，遇见了正要关店的店主陆川，两人因为一本绝版画册聊了起来。
edits: p02.description: "girl" → "woman"（避免把 24 岁的主角画得年幼）
